name: add-the-image
displayName: Add The Image – Paste Clipboard Image into Markdown Image Links
description: Hover a Markdown image link ![alt](path) with an empty or missing path and click + to save the copied image (screenshot or file) to that exact path and file name. Fills empty paths, fixes broken/missing images, replaces existing images.

commands.title: Add The Image: Save clipboard image into the image link under the cursor

addTheImage.defaultFolder.description: Folder (relative to the Markdown file) used when the link path is empty, e.g. ![cat]().

addTheImage.askForNameWhenEmpty.description: When the link path is empty, let you confirm or edit the generated file path before saving.

addTheImage.showForExistingImages.description: Also show a 'Replace image' button when hovering links whose file already exists.
